title: Israel Strikes Tyre Before Warning While Trump Claims Peace Deal Imminent — June 9 2026

Reuters explicitly reported Israel "launched deadly strike on Lebanon's Tyre before warning" — the IDF issued an evacuation order for the entire city of Tyre, including the Christian quarter, before attacking. telemetry: The temporal sequence matters: Reuters says the strike came "before warning" — meaning the evacuation order was either retroactive justification or issued as bombs were already in flight. The inclusion of the Christian quarter (where displaced people were sheltering) in the evacuation zone suggests either intelligence failure or deliberate targeting of a known civilian concentration point — a potential LOAC violation.
